name: komgajs
description: Portage à plat du backend Komga en TypeScript

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && node tools/gen-git-properties.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:native: npm run build:native:sqlite && npm run build:native:jpeg && npm run build:native:bcrypt && npm run build:native:zxing
scripts.build:native:sqlite: mkdir -p build && gcc -O2 -shared -fPIC -o build/komgasqlite.so native/komga_sqlite.c -I node_modules/better-sqlite3/deps/sqlite3 -licui18n -licuuc
scripts.build:native:jpeg: mkdir -p build && gcc -O3 -shared -fPIC -fvisibility=hidden -fno-strict-aliasing -ffp-contract=off -DNDEBUG -DCMS_DONT_USE_FAST_FLOOR -DCMS_NO_HALF_SUPPORT -I"$(node -p "require('path').resolve(process.execPath, '../../include/node')")" -o build/komgajpeg.node native/komga_jpeg.c native/libjpeg6b/*.c native/lcms2/*.c -lm -Wl,-Bsymbolic
